meta.title: Jungle Padel — indoor padel club in Pantelimon · Opening March 2027
meta.description: Indoor padel on 4 courts, the ranked Jungle league, Reformer pilates, a specialty café and DJ nights. On Șoseaua Biruinței, next to Selgros Pantelimon. Join the waitlist.

hero.lead: Indoor padel, the Jungle league, Reformer pilates and a specialty café — under palm trees, hanging plants and club lights.
hero.note: The 3D scene is an illustration, not a photo of the club.

club.title: More than a court. A whole evening in the jungle.
club.lead: Come to play, stay for the vibe: sport, café, music and community in one place.

padel.title: 4 indoor padel courts
padel.text: Enclosed courts in a hall heated in winter and cooled in summer. Play in any season.

league.title: The Jungle league
league.text: Official matches, points, ranks and live leaderboards. Beat stronger players, climb faster.

pilates.title: Reformer pilates
pilates.text: A separate studio with Reformer machines and classes for beginners, advanced players, athletes and mums.

cafe.title: Café & mezzanine
cafe.text: Specialty coffee and a mezzanine 3 m up, overlooking the courts.

events.title: DJ nights
events.text: Speakers, club lights and parties: padel doesn't stop at sunset.

room.title: Event room
room.text: A separate space for private parties of 15–20 people.

league.title: Play. Earn points. Rank up.
league.lead: A league ranked like competitive games: every official match moves your points, and your rank shows how well you play. Seasons last 3 months, so the race always stays open.

facts.live: Live leaderboards, online and in the club

location.title: East Bucharest, a step from the city.
location.address: Șoseaua Biruinței, next to Selgros Pantelimon
location.parking: Parking: 18 spaces at the back + 10 at the front
